title: Photochemical on-demand production of hydrogen peroxide in a modular flow reactor
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01142B, Paper

Thomas Freese, Jelmer T. Meijer, Matteo Miola, Paolo P. Pescarmona, Ben L. Feringa
Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) is a green oxidant and potential energy carrier. Using iron oxide nanoparticles in a photo-flow reactor, an improved H2O2 production of >14× over batch conditions was obtained, achieving solutions of 0.02 wt% H2O2.
